name: Yan (Liu Shouguang)
alt: Later Yan Empire of Liu Shouguang

predecessors.name: Tang dynasty
predecessors.text: the Lulong circuit round You Prefecture (Youzhou), 'near present-day Beijing'

successors.name: Jin (Former Jin)
successors.text: the whole Yan realm, conquered by Li Cunxu's Jin

ledger.x: 911: Liu Shouguang proclaims the Yan at You Prefecture.
913: Li Cunxu's Jin destroys the Yan.

wars.name: Jin conquest of Yan
wars.outcome: Zhou put You Prefecture under siege by summer 913; Liu Shouguang fled with his wives and children, was captured, and the Yan was destroyed; the Yan page dates the end to 914.

certainty.note: The Yan realm is known only as the area round You Prefecture near Beijing; no page gives its prefectures or a frontier.
